method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text, seat-neutral core with regulative rules where the text states duties, and a seat layer for the individual, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (income earned outside Ontario, non-residents, split income, minimum tax, tax years other than 2026 and benefit months outside July 2026 to June 2027 answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

A), e-Laws consolidation from 2026-07-01 to the e-Laws currency date 2026-10-14 (last amendment 2026, c. 2, Sched. 15), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/S.O.-2007-c.-11-Sched.-A.txt. Indexed amounts for 2026 from CRA T4127 (January 2026) and for July 2026 to June 2027 from the CRA Ontario programs page (modified 2026-07-30), both deposited 2026-10-24 beside the Act.

scope: Individual resident in Ontario on the last day of the year with no income earned outside Ontario, taxation year 2026: s 3 (1) rates and tax base; s 4 (1), (3); s 5 (1); s 6 (1); s 9 (2), (3), (4), (8), (9), (10), (12), the rest of s 9 an input; s 16 (1), (2); ss 19.1 and 21 as inputs; s 20 (1)-(7), (9); s 21.1 (1), (2), (3.1), (4); s 24 (0.1), (1), (2); s 115 (1) (a), (7). Benefits, July 2026 to June 2027: s 104 (4), (5), (5.1), (6.2), (8), (9) (Ontario child benefit); s 103.8 (2)-(4) (Ontario sales tax credit). Out: the Ontario allocation factor (income outside Ontario, non-residents), trusts, split income, minimum tax, ss 14, 15, 17-19, the under-18 disability supplement, s 103.8 (5), the other Trillium Benefit credits (ss 103.9-103.13), other Part IV credits, other years.
seat: the individual taxpayer and benefit recipient resident in Ontario
